title: `Eid ul-Adha Suhbah
body:
As-salaamu `alaykum wa rahmatullahi wa barakaatuh!
Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, laa ilaaha illa-Llah. Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd! 7x
The time for `Eid salaah has entered and we shall pray it. `Eid Mubarak to everyone!
A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytani 'r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmani 'r-Raheem. We are reaching the last part
of the life of Man in this dunya. I don’t know if it will be this year or next year that big Signs of Qiyaamah will
start.
We are, alhamdulillah, in peace here. Only people who run after Shaytan leave their Lord's servanthood.
Therefore, day by day more difficult positions appear, which make Shaytan happy and make our Creator,
Allah Almighty, unhappy and sorrowful about us.
O People! Run to Allah and to His Beloved Rasool (s) and you will be happy here and Hereafter! So many
advices you listen to but do not follow. Most people are running after Shaytan, while Allah Almighty is saying:
••••••••••• ••••••
w ’as-sulhu khayr. Peace is good for you. (an-Nisa, 4:128)

O Man! Don’t be be enemies; try to be brothers and sisters. I like peace for you.” However, Shaytan is saying,
“No! Fight each other!” but up to what point? So many kings and jabaabira, tyrants, are killing now, and what
happened for them? Nothing.
O People! I don't know when I am going. I hope to go with a brilliant face and with my heart full of imaan.
Everyone must try to do this: ask to reach that station and be peaceful, as Allah Almighty loves peaceful
servants and not those who quarrel and fight.
O People! Keep haqqullah, the rights of Allah Almighty, and the advice of the Holy Prophet (s). Try to keep
the rights for everyone; even an ant has rights, so give everyone their rights. Don't say this or that, as you will
leave and go, and the end of this life just approached. This may be my last advice for `Eid for everyone, He
knows. Yaa Rasoolullah, intercede for us! Yaa Rasoolullah, send us that one who will allow us to give
everyone's right and to destroy the tyrants; send us a sultan!
I’m entrusting all of you to Allah’s care. I am giving all of you to the Seal of Prophets (s) and to his followers,
awliyaullah. I am asking them to send us Mahdi (a) who is going to give everyone’s rights fully. Pray for me
and for all nations to adapt their ways the the ways of Heavens, not the ways of Hell!
May Allah forgive me and forgive you and send us (what we ask)!
He is al-Qaadir al-Muqtadir! But when you are doing something against His holy laws it brings trouble and
crisis to Man, so come follow the holy orders of Heavens. Don’t say you want democracy, but keep
Shari`atullah because Allah Almighty sent it and if you are asking for something else, Allah Almighty's
heavenly anger will befall you!
O Nations! Keep yourself from east to west! May Allah forgive us, for the honor of His Beloved, the Seal of
Prophets, Sayyidina Muhammad (s)!
Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, laa ilaaha illa-Llah. Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbar, wa lillahi 'l-hamd!
For the love of Prophet (s) and Allah (swt) we intend to pray Salaat al-`Eid al-Adha. You may follow the
imaam in takbeers. We may pray inshaa-Allah.

(Takbeerat)
